content: The basalt cliffs of Southfall Head rose two hundred feet above the raging sea. Gale-force winds whipped spray off the breakers, freezing into salt-crust along the jagged black stone. The clouds had begun to part, revealing a sliver of icy dawn light that turned the churning Atlantic into sheets of bruised jade.
critique: Sanderson: Strong biological limits and mechanical vector precision.
